messages:
Samir (PM): quick one — our cross-func roadmap sync is clashing w/ the RFC review next week. can we pick a new slot and owners for agenda items?
Alex (Eng): ugh, yeah my week is full Tue/Wed afternoons. prefer Mon/Wed mornings PT.
Maria (Product Ops): noting constraints — customer advisory on Wed 11a PT, so avoid that.
Elaine (Research): i can do any morning, but need 30m for the eval regression notes in the agenda.
Jorge (Design): design review for the new onboarding flow is Wed 10a PT — would block that window too.
Samir (PM): options: Mon 10a PT, Tue 9a PT, Thu 9:30a PT. propose Mon 10a PT as default.
Alex (Eng): Mon 10a PT works for me.
Maria (Product Ops): Mon 10a PT works, i'll send calendar invite and include conferencing + dial-in.
Elaine (Research): +1 for Mon 10a. Samir — can you add the eval regression slot and owner?
Samir (PM): assigning agenda owners: roadmap highlights (Samir), RFC review (Alex), design rollups (Jorge), eval regressions (Elaine), open priority disputes (Maria).
Alex (Eng): for RFC review — can we do a short preread? i'll post a 2-paragraph summary and key decision points in the doc by EOD Fri.
Jorge (Design): will attach the mockups and a short walkthrough gif. hoping to keep design rollup to 10m.
Maria (Product Ops): i'll run the meeting and keep timeboxes. also adding a decision-log section in the shared doc so we can capture outcomes + assignees.
Samir (PM): FYI we need to surface two priority disputes: (1) batching vs cache work order, (2) dedicated infra sizing for the new quantized models. owners please come prepared with tradeoffs + ask.
Alex (Eng): noted — i'll bring perf numbers for batching tradeoffs and a recommended next step.
Elaine (Research): i'll summarize regressions impact and propose a rollback window if needed.
Maria (Product Ops): calendar invite sent to #product + eng leads. agenda doc: https://redwood.docs/roadmap-sync/1782004321 (prereads + templates).
DeployBot: Meeting created for Mon 10:00 PT, duration 45m. Conference link: https://meet.redwood/abc123
Samir (PM): perfect. final ask — everyone add 1-2 bullet preread items to the doc by Fri 5pm PT so we can keep the sync to decisions.
Alex (Eng): done. added perf appendix and a TL;DR. :thumbsup:
Jorge (Design): added mockups + annotated comments.
Elaine (Research): added eval summary and key prompts that regressed.
Maria (Product Ops): thanks all — will circulate final agenda + decision template on Mon morning before the sync.
Samir (PM): closing — if anything urgent pops up, ping me directly. otherwise see you Mon 10a PT. :rocket:
